_comment: THE ENTIRE BALANCE OF #294 LIVES IN THESE INGREDIENTS, and one of them is now a find.
A cage of rebar around soul sand, with the sculk that listens for something to be born, and
at the heart of it the Broken Spawner itself - a cage that has already done this once. Every
ingredient is depths-side or reclamation-side, so a spawner cannot be assembled from
THE BROKEN SPAWNER IS THE SECOND LEVER THIS RECIPE ASKED FOR (owner, 2026-09-07: broken
spawners should be used for crafting spawners). This comment used to say 'the blueprint is
permanent, so four Broken Spawners buy spawners forever and there is no second lever'. The
worry was right and the sentence was stale twice over: teardown stopped teaching anything in
#390, and the sheet is bought from the Buy Terminal for 1500 scrip at tier 7 - so the find
had no connection to a spawner at all, and the faucet ran with nothing metering it. Consuming
one per craft is the meter. It is 1 in 2000 depths pulls, about the Bucket's rarity, so
spawners are rate-limited rather than unlimited, and rate-limited is what a progression gate
is - the same reasoning that lets the Motor be find-only.
It replaces a single soul sand and nothing else moves, deliberately: the change is 'the find
is required now', not a re-costing of the rest. The teardown still yields a Machine Frame, so
this is a choice about what the find is worth rather than a new use for a spare one.
SpawnerIsMeteredTest pins it, because a comment was the only guard last time and it rotted.
